result.title: TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for time series reasoning, while models that reason over time series are usually with long chains of thought. However, this process often consumes thousands of tokens, directly leading to substantial latency during inference. In contrast, System 1 models such as Jev make decisions instantly and can naturally be an alternative, but raw time series are not compatible with the embedding space of these models, thus hindering the reasoning performance, especially when input series contain thousands of numeric points. In this paper, we make a very early attempt to propose a time series System 1 model, namely TimesJev. Specifically, we first formalize System 1 sufficiency in time series reasoning, which motivates a compressed representation for time series with key frequency patterns preserved. To construct this representation, we derive a dimension reduction objective that combines (i) a sufficiency divergence that measures the core information lost during compression, and (ii) a realizability divergence that quantifies the incompatibility of the System 1 model to the optimal prediction given this representation. We optimize this objective by learning time series compression with a gating mechanism for sufficiency, and then aligning the selected representation with the embedding space for realizability. Finally, experiments on 13 datasets demonstrate that TimesJev outperforms reasoning models by over 62% with 62.9% less inference time than their fine-tuned versions on average.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TimesJev，一个面向时间序列的 System 1 模型：把原始序列压缩为保留关键频率模式的表示，用「充分性散度」刻画压缩丢失的核心信息、用「可实现性散度」刻画模型对该表示的可用性，并以门控学习与嵌入空间对齐来优化，从而用即时决策替代长思维链推理，在 13 个数据集上更快且更准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以充分性/可实现性目标学习紧凑 latent 表示再对齐到模型嵌入空间的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、压缩是否引发信息坍缩与「解码不可用」，而「用单步决策替代长 CoT」也与推理成本与停止决策的兴趣相关。
